caption:
Cheech, our ride-sharing app, is live on Google Play, and the iOS version is on the way. 🚗

Ride-sharing looks simple from the passenger seat. Under the hood, it means solving some of the hardest problems in app development:

▸ Real-time location for riders and drivers
▸ Matching the right driver to the right rider
▸ Maps, routing and ETAs
▸ A great experience on both sides of the marketplace
▸ Trust and safety

We built it ourselves, end to end.

Building a marketplace or on-demand app? DM us APP and let's talk about yours.
